The '''senior combat instructor''' was a title used by the [[Baran Do]] Sage who was the head combat instructor at the [[Baran Do temple]] in [[Dor'shan/Legends|Dor'shan]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]].
